_comment: Assisto MEDICINE DATABASE (drug lookup) ADVANCED upgrade (SPEC v2.1 §21). {key:[bn,en]} -> camelCase getters. ICU {count} placeholder on medicineDbAlternativesTitle is ALREADY in app_*.arb (reused, not redefined here). NO Bangla literals live in any .dart (Bangla digits render at runtime from codepoints U+09E6..U+09EF). Merge bn -> app_bn.arb (index [0]), en -> app_en.arb (index [1]), then `flutter gen-l10n`. All keys are NEW (the existing medicineDb* keys are reused unchanged). No api.dart / models / urls / sidebar edits.
